test_title: PYST 41: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Five people, L, M, N, R and S are sitting in a straight row, facing north, but not necessarily in the same order. Only M sits between L and S. N sits to the immediate right of S. R sits to the immediate left of L. Who sits at the second position from the left end?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Five people, L, M, N, R and S are sitting in a straight row, facing north, but not necessarily in the same order

2) Only M sits between L and S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a70fd4d314edf69b5eeb7374f640e82577e5b946da249ae958ed1303c88d41b5.png] 

3) N sits to the immediate right of S

So case (ii) is rejected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc8d4e671de94d20d951f7ac05df5b5078c7f0734f37c3a21bf7d9e910334ae4.png] 

4) R sits to the immediate left of L

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc023908bdf9fc878f12053df3171820581b356e0f6e439704e8e228d22e1183.png] 

So, **L** sits at the second position from the left end.

Hence, option 1) is the correct answer.
